final_message:
The bug was in `cancel` in `billing/subscriptions.py`. The immediate-cancel path (`at_period_end=False`) had a stray `pass` where the transition to `canceled` belonged. The subscription never left its old status, and dunning later moved it to `unpaid` when retries ran out. I replaced the `pass` with `transition(ctx, subscription, "canceled")`.

I added your test to `tests/test_lifecycle.py`. The full suite passes (25 tests), including the new one.

I also wrote `answer.json` in the repo root:
```json
{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}
```

steps.command: cd billing && ls && grep -n "unpaid\|canceled\|def " *.py | grep -n "cancel\|unpaid\|retry\|final" | head -60
cd /tmp/bsvc-b099pe_q/billing-service && git log --oneline -3 -- billing/subscriptions.py; sed -n 25,50p billing/subscriptions.py; sed -n 30,50p billing/engine.py

sed -i '/^    pass$/c\    transition(ctx, subscription, "canceled")' billing/subscriptions.py && git diff --stat && echo '{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_tmp.py <<'E'
E
rm tests/test_tmp.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5
ls tests; cat answer.json; git status --short

echo '{"file": "subscriptions.py", "function": "cancel"}' > answer.json && cat >> tests/test_lifecycle.py <<'E'


def test_retries_exhausted_after_cancel_marks_uncollectible():
    from conftest import World

    w = World({"retry_offsets_days": [1], "final_action": "mark_unpaid"})
    cus = w.customer(last4="0002")
    sub = w.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(w.monthly["id"], 1)])
    w.engine.cancel(sub["id"], at_period_end=False)
    w.advance_days(1)
    [inv] = w.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert sub["status"] == "canceled"
    assert inv["status"] == "uncollectible"
E
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8
